hierarchy.relationEvidence: explicit Parent ID on each serialized statement row; adjacency/indent/color are not evidence
hierarchy.leaf: one financial line with supplied Amount and mapping/proof; maps may target leaves only
hierarchy.parent: supplied Amount is a control equal to immediate financial children, each child counted once; never a second contribution to category or grand totals
hierarchy.title: root presentation label with blank Parent ID, Line class and Amount; no financial children or mappings
hierarchy.ownership: one unique Node ID and at most one parent, all parent references present, no cycles; descendants retain one category
hierarchy.coverage: every TB account+Complete dimensions has exactly one mapping and one proof; every leaf including explicit zero is mapped; no unknown rows silently dropped
hierarchy.minimumEvidence: All four source roles must contain records; at least one TB account and one financial leaf. Header-only bundles and title-only statements cannot establish scope or financial evidence, even when all sums are zero.

money: plain signed decimal lexeme with at most two fraction digits; exact integer minor units; blank != zero; debit and credit nonnegative and cannot both be positive in one TB row; no rounding or floating-point inference Each input and final aggregate/net/contribution/control/category/grand-total/equation must have absolute minor units <= aggregateMinorAbsLimit; use exact integers, check final sums and their terms, do not reject legitimate intermediate cancellation.
proof: Independent supplied Account class/Line class/Sign/Line ID; strict real-calendar YYYY-MM-DD validity dates must inclusively cover the whole declared Period start..Period end with Valid from <= Valid to, not merely As of. Exact identity and dimensions; assets require debit-positive, liabilities/equity require credit-positive. Contra assets retain asset policy and may contribute negatively. No AI/label inference.
evidence: SHA256 original UTF-8 CSV bytes, CSV record row (header=1), column, raw text for each serialized field; positions are never manufactured from a canonical replacement
nextGate: review this contract and oracle; independently reserve new structural/financial holdout before product implementation; retain current flat-family behavior and all CI gates
